info.title: ParkingBreaker fake API
info.description: Volatile local preview. No real authentication, research, payments or mail.

schema.title: Response Current Appeal Auth Appeal Get
Response Stripe Webhook Webhooks Stripe Post

AcceptBeta.title: AcceptBeta
AcceptBeta.description: Customer consent to the exact free-beta disclosure; no payment or campaign input.

BetaAcceptanceReceipt.title: BetaAcceptanceReceipt
BetaAcceptanceReceipt.description: Durable zero-charge acceptance. Replays return the same persisted timestamps.

BetaFeedbackNoticePageInput.title: BetaFeedbackNoticePageInput
BetaFeedbackNoticePageInput.description: One saved photo in the customer's stated order; role is never inferred.

BetaFeedbackNoticePageView.title: BetaFeedbackNoticePageView
BetaFeedbackNoticePageView.description: Saved 1-based page order; no photo reference or storage path is exposed.

BetaFeedbackNoticeReceipt.title: BetaFeedbackNoticeReceipt
BetaFeedbackNoticeReceipt.description: Owner-safe receipt: no owner, case token, photo ref or payload digest.

BetaFeedbackNoticeRequest.title: BetaFeedbackNoticeRequest
BetaFeedbackNoticeRequest.description: Customer-reported notice metadata only; no owner, status or evidence claims.

BetaFeedbackReportedFields.title: BetaFeedbackReportedFields
BetaFeedbackReportedFields.description: Exactly what the customer reported, uninterpreted; never an agency deadline claim.

BetaOffer.title: BetaOffer
BetaOffer.description: Read-only view of one selected free entitlement; never a payment or mailing offer.

DeclarationView.title: DeclarationView
DeclarationView.description: One official declaration the customer must affirm. Never pre-checked.

DestinationAddress.title: DestinationAddress
DestinationAddress.description: A complete US postal destination the customer supplies. Never inferred or defaulted.

DestinationChoice.title: DestinationChoice
DestinationChoice.description: A pending customer-directed destination choice. Present only while one is required.

DestinationConsent.title: DestinationConsent
DestinationConsent.description:
Explicit acceptance bound to one saved address revision and the shown disclosure.

`accepted` has no default and must be the JSON boolean true.

Flag.title: Flag
Flag.description:
One failing span, or the whole draft when span_id is None.

MODE_BOUNDARY wins if any span problem is one. Whole-draft failures must be
rechecked after editing; they cannot be confirmed or cleared by a span action.

IntakeForm.title: IntakeForm
IntakeForm.description: Incomplete customer input, kept only in the existing private workspace.

ResearchView.title: ResearchView
ResearchView.description: The live research view: official pages opened and what they showed.

ReturnProofPacket.title: ReturnProofPacket
ReturnProofPacket.description:
Stored mailing records; never a claim of delivery or an agency decision.

Also the customer's mailing record for any accepted letter: the exact approved packet
and the provider's tracking events, not a USPS Return Receipt.

TicketConfirmationReceipt.title: TicketConfirmationReceipt
TicketConfirmationReceipt.description: A recorded customer confirmation, replayable by its exact command id.

TicketConfirmationRequest.title: TicketConfirmationRequest
TicketConfirmationRequest.description: One explicit confirmation command for the current saved envelope and review.

TicketConfirmationSnapshot.title: TicketConfirmationSnapshot
TicketConfirmationSnapshot.description: Current, stale (with a fixed reason) or missing confirmation. Never verification.

TicketDiscrepancyResolution.title: TicketDiscrepancyResolution
TicketDiscrepancyResolution.description: The customer's explicit answer to each non-match comparison; never inferred.

TicketFactBindingPayload.title: TicketFactBindingPayload
TicketFactBindingPayload.description:
The closed literal/adopted envelope the customer confirmed for their ticket.

It is validated by the accepted pure binding primitive; the import is local so the
binding module can keep depending on these wire models without a cycle. Dates stay
literal in ``literal`` and separately selected ISO calendar dates in ``adopted``.

TicketField.title: TicketField
TicketField.description: The closed field set. No other field is read, sent or returned.

TicketOperationRequest.title: TicketOperationRequest
TicketOperationRequest.description: One idempotent vision request; the caller's request id is the replay key.

TicketReadingField.title: TicketReadingField
TicketReadingField.description: One closed reading suggestion or an explicit absence state. Never a verified fact.

TicketReadingSnapshot.title: TicketReadingSnapshot
TicketReadingSnapshot.description: The current durable extraction for this workspace, replayable after a restart.

TicketReadingStatus.title: TicketReadingStatus
TicketReadingStatus.description: Owner-safe capability and durable snapshot; no claim token or operator internals.

TicketReviewField.title: TicketReviewField
TicketReviewField.description: One model comparison and the literal visible text; never adoption or verification.

basis.const: model comparison only; not external verification
basis.title: Basis
basis.default: model comparison only; not external verification

TicketReviewSnapshot.title: TicketReviewSnapshot
TicketReviewSnapshot.description: The current durable independent review for this workspace.

VehicleRelationship.title: VehicleRelationship
VehicleRelationship.description: Closed customer choices for the S3 standing question; never official findings.
